physical_manifest.scope: One fixed-RTL physical implementation; historical records are unchanged

proposal_rationale: Candidate 2 is untried in the complete captured baseline and candidate-1 history. Candidate 1 enabled both actions at baseline physical settings: cell area was 160081 versus 161954 um2 (1.16% smaller), but setup slack was -0.0262439 ns, hold slack 0.0945523 ns, and failure_classes were physical_execution and timing. Electrical violation counts were zero; physical_qualified and rank_eligible were false, energy_j was empty, and no Q improvement can be claimed. Its physical execution cost was 3601.748373 seconds; recorded elapsed_search_seconds was 3667.903144, which includes execution and must not be treated as agent-only budget consumption. One of three candidate evaluations is captured; this proposal uses one remaining slot. Keep utilization=40, density=0.55, abc_area=0 and repair_margin=0, and disable operand isolation while retaining the proved exact signed 18-bit reduction. Width reduction targets arithmetic cell area and switching; removing input masking may ease delay and removes gating overhead but sacrifices potential idle-switching savings. Placement changes mean candidate 1 does not identify which action caused the timing failure; this is a measured follow-up hypothesis. Baseline setup slack was 0.19292 ns; avoid area-oriented mapping, density changes or unsupported electrical repair given the narrow timing margin and zero electrical violations. Optimize Q=(cell_area_um2/161954)*geomean(E_DOT64/2.293945631906608e-7,E_GEMM8/1.7792685987008622e-6,E_CONV3/1.1542462882162743e-6). Require physical_qualified, measurement_qualified and rank_eligible before comparing area_ratio, energy_ratio and score. Inspect setup/hold slack, electrical_violations, correctness and activity/parasitic annotation checks, all three energy_j and estimated_power_w entries, failure_classes and execution costs. Retain the failed record and the best qualified result, currently the baseline with Q=1. Energy conclusions remain limited to Liberty-model zero-delay post-route activity plus extracted SPEF; candidate 2 has no measured outcome yet.
